data.one_liner: A Flutter widget for creating an expandable table with fixed headers and first columns.
data.what_it_does: Provides an ExpandableTable widget that supports nested expandable rows and columns with vertical and horizontal scrolling. It keeps the header and first column fixed while allowing custom cell heights, widths, and animations.
use_when: You need a hierarchical or tree-structured table data view with expandable rows and columns.
You need fixed headers and a fixed first column alongside vertical and horizontal scrolling.
avoid_when: You only need a standard, flat grid or data table without expandable nested rows and columns.
You require complex chart visualisations rather than tabular text/widget cells.
strengths: Supports nested rows and columns grouped in expandable structures.
Fixed header and first column with vertical and horizontal scrolling.
External controller support for dynamically managing rows and columns.
weaknesses: Limited to table layouts with expandable rows and columns.
Not documented for database ORM or state management patterns beyond basic controller management.
